text.p: -- Bankers Trust said it lowered its rating on ITT Corp to market perform from buy.

-- "We are lowering our rating on ITT Corp ... in light of Hilton Hotels Corp's hostile bid for the company and the corresponding rise in ITT's stock price. Although additional upside potential remains, it is our judgement that incremental upside could be limited to about five percent to 10 percent, suggesting that a market perform rating is appropriate," according to the analyst research note.

-- "With Hilton's hostile $55 per share bid for ITT Corp, the price of ITT now exceeds our 12-month price target of $55. ... Although we think Hilton may evenutally determine to raise its bid, we do not anticipate upside beyond the $60 to $65 level," the note said.

-- "ITT's management and board have indicated that Hilton's offer will be considered, and that the company will make its recommendation to shareholders within 10 business days. Without additional information, we cannot ascertain management's ability to identify more attractive alternatives," according to the analyst's note.
-- ITT shares gained 1-1/8 at 57-7/8 in afternoon New York Stock Exchange trade and Hilton shares were up 1-1/4 to 28-7/8.
